008package paint.compare;
009
010import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVFormat;
011import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVParser;
012import org.apache.commons.csv.CSVRecord;
013
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.io.Reader;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import java.nio.file.Files;
018import java.nio.file.Path;
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.Map;
023
024/**
025 * Reads a CSV file into a list of {@code column -> value} row maps for
026 * {@link TableComparer}.
027 *
028 * <p>Uses Apache Commons CSV so quoted fields containing commas, embedded
029 * quotes, and newlines are parsed correctly — unlike the hand-rolled
030 * {@code line.split(",")} the old comparators used, which corrupts any such
031 * field. Values are trimmed; a column absent from a row maps to {@code ""}.</p>
032 */
033public final class CsvSource {
034
035    private CsvSource() {
036    }
037
038    public static List<Map<String, String>> read(Path csv) throws IOException {
039        List<Map<String, String>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
040
041        CSVFormat format = CSVFormat.DEFAULT.builder()
042                .setHeader()
043                .setSkipHeaderRecord(true)
044                .setTrim(true)
045                .setIgnoreEmptyLines(true)
046                .build();
047
048        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(csv, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
049             CSVParser parser = format.parse(reader)) {
050
051            List<String> headers = parser.getHeaderNames();
052            for (CSVRecord record : parser) {
053                Map<String, String> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
054                for (String header : headers) {
055                    row.put(header, record.isMapped(header) ? record.get(header) : "");
056                }
057                rows.add(row);
058            }
059        }
060        return rows;
061    }
062}
